name: insb
synopsis: void insb(unsigned short port, void *addr, unsigned long count);
description: insb performs low-level input of a series of bytes from a specified I/O port into a memory buffer. It is designed for internal kernel use but can be accessed from user space with proper permissions.

parameters.name: port
parameters.description: The I/O port to read from

parameters.name: addr
parameters.description: Pointer to the buffer where the input data will be stored

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Number of bytes to input from the port

return_value.failure: May result in segmentation fault if I/O permissions are not set
